item.title: Chromatic Splash Cold Shoulder Hoodie
item.description: Redefine the rules of luxury streetwear with a high fashion piece conceived for the contemporary woman. This hoodie subverts the classic through a high-impact asymmetric silhouette featuring an exposed single shoulder supported by a subtle technical strap. The visual proposal presents a vibrant off-white canvas covered by a kaleidoscopic pattern of abstract splatters. The classic signature monogram stands out subtly on the chest in a minimalist stroke.

item.title: Stellar Silhouette Asymmetric Sweatshirt
item.description: Redefine urban elegance with this haute couture piece. Conceived with a sophisticated asymmetric neckline exposing a single shoulder via a subtle technical strap. It merges with a dramatic fluid batwing sleeve. The white canvas displays an all-over graphic black star pattern. The signature handwritten monogram stands out in royal violet on the chest. A creation available made-to-order with worldwide shipping.

item.description: Engineered to balance athletic precision with understated refinement, this sun visor is crafted from soft, premium cotton. Each piece is made to order and accompanied by worldwide shipping.
